clearedSpotChecks.check: Celo fee currency handling and the journal, read in celo-kona at the celo/reth-v1.0.10 tag
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/celo-org/celo-kona/celo/reth-v1.0.10/crates/celo-revm/src/handler.rs (3093 lines). cip64_rollbackable_debit_and_deduct_caller (616-690) takes a journal checkpoint (635), commits it on success (643) and clears transient storage (668), or reverts it whole (678). validate_against_state_and_deduct_caller starts at 1056. build_execution_result (864-880) calls cip64_credit_fee_currency at 876, after the main frames have returned. cip64_credit_fee_currency returns early for deposits and CELO-paid transactions (258-272), so system sub-calls do not re-enter it. The core_contracts.rs path given in the cleared item returns 404; the file is at crates/celo-revm/src/contracts/core_contracts.rs, and its call_inner (211-249) clears transient storage and restores transaction_id only on the committing path, as the item says. The debit runs before the user's frames and the credit after them, so neither can leave a PoolManager transient word set or undo part of a user frame. Lock, NonzeroDeltaCount, CurrencyReserves and CurrencyDelta keep their state in transient storage (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25, src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:14-32, src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:17-36, src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:21-39). The only correction is the source path.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3: where Arc's native value hook sits against the call frame checkpoint, read in arc-node v0.8.6 crates/evm/src/evm.rs
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/circlefin/arc-node/v0.8.6/crates/evm/src/evm.rs (9571 lines). checked_frame_init (807-837) calls before_frame_init before init_frame. is_address_blocklisted (438-452) reads NATIVE_COIN_CONTROL_ADDRESS through journal.sload. Under Zero7 the selfdestructed-target probe is wrapped in checkpoint and checkpoint_revert (569-580). For non-precompile calls, init_deferred_frame_with_transfer_log (869-891) pushes the Transfer log after init_frame, so the child checkpoint's log index comes before it and a revert truncates it. For precompile calls the log is pushed inside its own checkpoint (845-865). The same file also has a path the cleared item does not cover. In the subcall precompile path (about 940-1260) the precompile can make the child's caller tx.origin. That path takes a checkpoint and commits it at once (1052-1053), then later rolls back through revert_subcall_checkpoint (1249 onward) by taking a dummy checkpoint and reverting to the saved one. I added this as a lead. It is not a counterexample: a caller swapped to tx.origin only acts for the transaction's own signer.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 5: the cycle 32 nested-frame probe (200 programs, seed 3204, code overrides, eth_call) on the public endpoints, bracketed by web3_clientVersion
clearedSpotChecks.note: The recorded files show 200 of 200 equal and 0 mismatches for live-journal-42220.json (forno.celo.org) and live-journal-196.json (rpc.xlayer.tech). The Arc results are in live-journal-5042off/pn/bd.json, not the 5042 name the summary implies. I ran my own probe by eth_call with code overrides. A parent does TSTORE(1,5). It calls a child that does TSTORE(1,7) and SSTORE(2,9) and then reverts. The parent then reads TLOAD(1), SLOAD(2) and the call result. Results: forno.celo.org (reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb, block 0x5008c26), rpc.xlayer.tech (reth/v2.3.0-f60420a/xlayer/v0.0.7, block 0x497bef3), rpc.mainnet.arc.io (arc/v1, block 0x1ff17ed) and arc-rpc.publicnode.com (reth/v2.2.0-508cbdf, block 0x1ff17ee) each returned TLOAD 5, SLOAD 0 and success 0, which the EIP-1153 and revm journal rules require. The client strings match those in the cleared item. The caveat it already states stands: endpoint answers do not prove the block-producing node runs the same image.
